Import a GCMS-ID predicted spectral library

Source: R/read_gcms_id.R
read_gcms_id.Rd

Import a GCMS-ID predicted spectral library

Usage

read_gcms_id(
  file,
  backend = c("auto", "memory", "sqlite"),
  db_file = NULL,
  batch_size = 1000L,
  max_spectra = Inf
)

Arguments

file

Extracted GCMS-ID CSV file from its public downloads page.

backend, db_file, batch_size

Storage options as in [read_msp()].

max_spectra

Maximum number of CSV records to import.

Value

A GCMSlibrary object with predicted spectra and predicted RI provenance.

Details

The GCMS-ID columns compound_name, inchikey, compound_formula, retention_index_value, exact_mass and peak_list are read in batches. The StdNP, SemiStdNP and StdPolar name suffixes identify DB1, DB5 and DBWAX phase classes. Records with different RI predictions are retained separately. Unknown suffixes retain an unknown phase. All source columns are preserved.

See also

<https://gcms-id.ca/downloads>
